config.targetLanguage: Target language for translations. Selecting English text translates to Chinese; selecting Chinese text translates back to English.
config.engine: Translation engine. `auto` uses the built-in free chain (Google → MyMemory → LibreTranslate → Youdao → Bing). Paid engines require an API key.
config.engine.bing: Bing / Microsoft Edge Translate (free, no key)
config.fallback: When the selected engine fails, automatically try the next available engine.
config.hover.enabled: Show a translation when hovering over a word.
config.hover.delay: Delay in milliseconds before the hover translation request starts.
config.hover.maxLength: Maximum word length for hover translation.
config.inline.enabled: Show inline translations after comments or string literals.
config.inline.mode: Which content gets an inline translation.
config.inline.maxLines: Maximum number of lines processed per request.
config.dictionary.offline: Use the built-in ECDICT offline dictionary for phonetics and meanings (no network).
config.dictionary.online: Also query online dictionaries (Youdao, dictionaryapi.dev) for richer meanings and examples.
config.cache.ttlHours: How long cached translations stay valid.
config.cache.maxEntries: Maximum number of cached translation entries.
config.proxy: HTTP proxy, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:7890`. Leave empty to auto-detect from the editor, environment variables, or the macOS system proxy.
config.panelColumn.beside: Open in a new column beside the editor
config.autoPlay: Automatically pronounce the word when the panel opens.
config.uiLanguage: UI language for the translation panel. `auto` follows the IDE language.
config.glossary: Project glossary. Keys are words or identifiers and values are the preferred translations. Glossary entries take precedence over machine translation.
config.glossaryPath: Path to a JSON glossary file, e.g. `.lingua/glossary.json`. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.
config.vocabularyPath: Path to the vocabulary notebook JSON file. Defaults to the extension global storage.
config.libretranslate.url: LibreTranslate base URL. Use your own instance for reliability.
config.deepl.apiKey: DeepL API key. Free keys usually end with `:fx`.
config.openai.baseUrl: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Works with proxies and local gateways.
